items.experiment: Plain-base T 1.0 wrong rate on the problems where top8 plain gives a quick finished-wrong answer.
Difficulty-controlled contrast: plain-base T 1.0 wrong rate on top8's quick-wrong problems minus its wrong rate on top8-right problems that the cued base solves in at least 3 of 4 samples.
Plain-base T 0.6 wrong rate (a second, independent plain sample) on the problems where top8 plain gives a quick finished-wrong answer.

Difficulty dependence of the plain register at T 0.6. The same contrast on the plain base's T 0.6 / top-p 0.95 answers that do not self-open: accuracy on cued-4/4 problems minus accuracy on cued <= 1/4 problems.

Per-problem persistence of plain-base failures at fixed difficulty. On problems the cued base solves in all 4 samples, the plain-base T 1.0 wrong rate when the plain-base T 0.6 answer to the same problem is wrong, minus the T 1.0 wrong rate when that T 0.6 answer is right.
